meta.source: Reference video: dishwasher explainer (720×1280, 101s), colours sampled from frames

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and scene ground. Every frame sits on it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Lit faces of drawn objects, callout chip fill, cards that sit on paper.

tokens.name: paper-grid
tokens.usage: Graph-paper lines behind illustrations, at grid-cell pitch. Never for text.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Recessed panel behind a summary illustration (outro card, thumbnails).

tokens.name: khaki
tokens.usage: Body fill of drawn appliances and objects (front faces).

tokens.name: khaki-deep
tokens.usage: Shadow side of drawn objects; colour of the hatch pattern lines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All outlines, frame borders and body text on paper, paper-raised and panel.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, durations, legend notes) on paper and paper-raised. 5.7:1 light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Starting colour of the ink-in reveal and of not-yet-active words. Decorative only, never resting text.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Leader lines, dividers under the illustration, inactive ring track. Marks only (3.7:1).

tokens.name: heat
tokens.usage: Meaning: heat, temperature, the brand. Heater coil, timer ring, big numerals, brand mark. Text only at 24px+ (3.5:1 light). Never a fill under small text: use heat-text.

tokens.name: heat-text
tokens.usage: Heat keyword in text under 24px, category tag, links. 5.1:1 on paper light, 7.2:1 dark. Also the fill of an active filter pill, with on-heat text (6:1).

tokens.name: heat-soft
tokens.usage: Hot surfaces in drawings (heated plates, food); tinted glow around hot objects.

tokens.name: on-heat
tokens.usage: Icons on a heat fill (play glyph, 4.1:1) and text on a heat-text fill (active filter, 6:1).

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Meaning: water and liquid. Pipes, spray jets, bubble outlines, water keyword in text, water numerals. 4.9:1 on paper light, 6.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: water-body
tokens.usage: Fill of a volume of water seen in section. Ink and water outlines read on it.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Meaning: mechanical part or active ingredient (spray arm, enzyme layer). Fill only.

tokens.name: olive-text
tokens.usage: Mechanical-part keyword in text and in callout chips. 5.1:1 on paper light, 9.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element.

families.sans: "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.sample: إزاي غسالة الأطباق بتغسل بحوالي جردل مية بس؟
styles.usage: Episode question on the intro and outro frame and the page hero. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings, brand line under the timer ring.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: إزاي التلاجة بتبرد من غير ما تتلج؟
styles.usage: Video card titles in the library grid.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: وتحت فيه سخان... زي سخان الحمام.
styles.usage: Two-line scene caption under the illustration. Keywords inside take a meaning colour.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: المية بتلف في دايرة: تنزل للحوض، تعدي على الفلتر، وترجع تطلع من الدراع تاني.
styles.usage: Episode descriptions and long text on the content page. Max 60ch.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Callout chips, legend items, filter pills.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Category tag, brand line in the frame corner, durations.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The one key number of an episode (litres, degrees, minutes). Coloured by meaning.

styles.name: numeral-sm
styles.usage: Secondary readings inside a scene (thermometer, ×3 counter).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a callout dot and its leader line, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip inner padding (inline), legend row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between caption lines and the divider.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Frame inner inset, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Frame inset of the double border; section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: grid-cell
tokens.usage: Pitch of the graph-paper grid. Illustrations align to it.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Frames, cards, panels, buttons. The system is square-cornered like a drawing sheet.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Callout label chips only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Inset magnifier circles, numbered legend dots, the timer ring.

stroke.note: Line weights of the technical drawing, at 1x web scale.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Grid lines, hatch lines, leader lines, inner frame line.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Object outlines inside illustrations, dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-frame
tokens.usage: Scene frame border, card border, the ring.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: The one emphasised part of a scene (the layer being explained).
